verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no material on SOC 2 or other compliance attestations, a trust center, data-handling policies, or datacenter tier certifications. The cited security features (per-cluster VPC isolation, bare-metal nodes without a hypervisor, API access tokens) are adjacent controls, not a way to verify the provider's compliance posture. This axis clearly applies to a GPU cloud provider, so the lack of evidence yields none.
